proxy.baseline: released evidenceFamaProxy: currentSessionRecall - lambda * obsoleteExposure, clipped at zero
proxy.candidate: currentSessionRecall - lambda * stanceWeightedObsoleteExposure, clipped at zero
proxy.lambda: forgetting evaluation criteria divided by all evaluation criteria
proxy.aggregation: score each frozen case-arm, then arithmetic mean over all 200 cases

alignment.policyRankStatistic: Kendall tau-b across all 13 frozen policies
alignment.pairwiseStatistic: sign agreement against V1 over the 12 challengers

decisionRule: D17 succeeds only if the stance-aware proxy improves Kendall tau-b with answer FAMA by at least 0.10 and predicts the observed V2-versus-V1 FAMA direction. It is a diagnostic proxy result, not a policy promotion.
claimBoundary: Marker-based stance is intentionally bounded and English-specific. The experiment tests proxy alignment on Memora contexts already frozen by D16; it does not establish end-to-end correction extraction or human semantic correctness.
